flowRoot.flowPara: TIP: Leave the booklet open to this page as you will use these skills frequently!
TIP: This is your Innate skill. That means its always active. In tandem with the Mods detailed below, it's a vital part of the Techsage's skill-set.
TIP: This is your Basic skill. It's a lot weaker than most of your other skills, but it never needs to recharge.
At start of turn, put 1 Energy mark on one of your Mods.
As a free reactive action, you may consume an Energy mark to Overload a mod. You gain double the maximum active bonus of that mod until end of turn.
Strike target foe for 4 damage, plus 1 bonus damage for each different mod that has an Energy mark on it.
Active: Your strikes against foe's you've already struck this turn deal 3 bonus damage.
Active: Your armor is increased by 2.
Active: The ranges of your skills and effects are increased by 2.
